in_marathi.name: Yadunandan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yadunandan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yadunandan is a Sanskrit name for 'God's gift'. It is derived from the words 'Yadu' meaning 'God' and 'Nandan' meaning 'gift'. This name is believed to be a symbol of divine blessings and bestowed upon those who are worthy of God's grace.
